stills.name: coffee-shop-sapling
stills.description: ARCHITECTURAL COMPOSITION PLAN (composed like an architect draws a site plan, every element placed by intention): Frame is 16:9 wide anamorphic landscape.
stills.prompt: Bespoke editorial photograph. ARCHITECTURAL COMPOSITION PLAN (composed like an architect draws a site plan, every element placed by intention): Frame is 16:9 wide anamorphic landscape. Character sits at the golden-ratio intersection at approximately 61.8% from left · 61.8% from top (lower-right φ-point), occupying less than 22% of frame height, small in the vast interior around her. FOREGROUND PLANE (left third · 0-33% frame width): the handmade walnut and blackened-steel service counter cuts diagonally across the lower-left, La Marzocco Linea Classic AV espresso machine in cream lacquer as sculptural silhouette, one antique brass Edison-bulb pendant light hanging in from the top-left corner, softly bokeh-blurred. MIDGROUND PLANE (center-right · 33-70%): a small round Carrara marble table with antique-brass base, and the young woman seated at it, in sharp focus, angled three-quarters away from camera toward the window. BACKGROUND PLANE (right two-thirds · 30-100%): a floor-to-ceiling east-facing window fills the vertical, filling the right half of the frame; through the glass at soft focus is the street where city workers in canvas-tan work jackets and burnt-sienna beanies are actively placing a very young Japanese Zelkova sapling (~1.2m tall) into a fresh sidewalk cutout, burlap root ball still visible at base, ceremonial planting motion, wood tree stakes beside the hole. LIGHT DIRECTION: motivated natural key from the east-facing window at 9 o'clock, 30-degree elevation, soft cool morning light; overhead Edison-bulb pendants provide warm ambient counter-light at 2700K but stay subordinate. BESPOKE DETAIL: The woman is early-twenties, dark hair in a low natural knot, wearing an artisan-knit cream Aran cardigan in Norwegian wool with a cable pattern, slim tailored charcoal wool trousers, one thin gold chain. Both hands anatomically resolved: one wraps a matte off-white handmade thick-walled ceramic cup (East Fork Pottery register) with steam curling upward, the other rests flat on the marble beside the saucer. Interior further considered: nordic-oak wide-plank floors receding into depth, exposed dark steel beams above, warm off-white plaster walls, one small ficus in a matte terracotta pot on the far counter, no branded signage anywhere. HIGH-FASHION EDITORIAL LIGHTING (Peter Lindbergh window-portraiture register): sculptural single-source natural key, deep controlled negative fill on the woman's shadow side producing painterly chiaroscuro, rim light through her hair from the window. DEPTH CUES: foreground counter and pendant bokeh-blurred (out of focus), midground woman sharp (in focus), background sapling-planting scene very soft focus behind glass. SHOT SPEC: ARRI ALEXA 65 with Zeiss Master Anamorphic 40mm, aperture f/2.0, Kodak Vision3 500T warm film grain. Locked static camera. No text, no logos, no LED elements, no readable menu. THEMATIC LAYER (the beauty of technology done right): the technology this woman uses to run her work is invisible in the frame — no laptop, no phone, no LED, no screen anywhere; only her presence, the ceramic cup, the marble, the light, and the world outside remain. The beauty is that technology has bought her this hour of contemplation, not stolen it. Quiet. Contemplative. Bespoke. Production-grade.
